title: Check the November application decisions
description: Confirm whether earlier Pearson steps were submitted. UBC admissions and award applications are due November 15. HKUST allows forthcoming scores, but priority-round treatment of later SAT results still needs checking.
steps: Check nomination and admission receipts for Pearson; do not assume the route is closed.
Check UBC nomination, teacher referee, and the separate award application.
Record a route status only after an explicit decision.

title: Find the December SAT registration ticket
description: Confirm the December 5 test date and assigned test center in the College Board account. Save the ticket in the profile evidence folder.
steps: Check the test date and location on the ticket.
Save a PDF or screenshot in 05_Profile_Evidence.
If a device loan is needed, check the earlier request cutoff.

title: Check the new PoliTO testing rules
description: The 2027/28 call is still being defined and the testing system is changing. Find the current official engineering call before relying on an older SAT exemption.
steps: Look for the exact engineering program, entry cycle, and accepted test.
Keep SAT acceptance unknown until a current call confirms it.

title: Check one Korean program’s graduation rule
description: Choose KAIST, POSTECH, DGIST, or GIST. Find whether the relevant 2027 intake accepts an expected-graduation school letter from a June graduate.
steps: Choose one program and its exact intake.
Save the source and record what still needs clarification.

title: Inventory family financial documents
description: Inventory family income, tax, household and property records before translation or legalization. Store the inventory in the financial document folder.
steps: Identify income or tax records already available digitally.
Identify available property and household records.
List missing items; verify the regional aid call before ordering translations.
